versions.changelog:
Version 0.1.2

- Removed old sample log files and the outdated skill-card documentation file.
- Added a .gitkeep placeholder file to the data directory to ensure its presence in version control.
- No changes to workflow, user experience, or functional behavior.

**Summary: Major change—skill now requires explicit user confirmation, tightens execution boundaries, and limits batch size per run.**

- Now only executes batch follow when platform, candidate list, and max batch size are all clearly confirmed by the user.
- Batch execution is strictly limited to up to 30 accounts per run, with preview and confirmation required for each batch.
- Only uses a dedicated, visible browser profile per platform for user login—no access to normal browser sessions or data.
- No headless, automated, or background evasion: all actions occur with user-involved, front-facing browser and stop on warnings or validation issues.
- All results—including partial or failed steps—are saved for audit, and only minimal necessary data written to the local asset library.
- Fuzzy, open-ended, or ambiguous requests will NOT trigger browser execution; only clear, confirmed input launches actions.
- Supported platform adaptation details are maintained in a dedicated reference file.

Initial release of blogger-auto-follow skill, enabling multi-platform intelligent blogger extraction and auto-follow.

- Extracts blogger lists from images or text (including video screenshots, PPTs, rankings) and automates bulk follow on Douyin, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, X/Twitter, and YouTube via local browser.
- Supports user login via manual QR code/password with unlimited wait; resumes automation after successful authentication.
- Implements very low-frequency human-like operation to avoid platform risk control; verifies and skips already-followed accounts.
- Manages a persistent local archive of blogger assets, supporting direct homepage link storage, incremental add/remove, and one-click multi-profile dynamic review.
- Supports both macOS and Windows systems.
- Asks for user confirmation if the target platform is unclear.
